```{r dash-testSummary, results='asis', echo=FALSE}
library(flexdashboard)
library(purrr)
library(dplyr)
library(knitr)
library(htmltools)
source(here::here(".engine/Utilities", "utils.R"))

# 1. Gather targeted runs metadata with timing metrics
test_meta <- raw_data %>%
  group_by(run_id) %>%
  summarise(
    sequence_num = first(sequence_num),
    project_name = first(project_name),
    test_name  = first(test_name),
    start_time = min(timestamp, na.rm = TRUE),
    end_time   = max(timestamp, na.rm = TRUE),
    duration   = round(as.numeric(difftime(max(timestamp, na.rm = TRUE), 
                                           min(timestamp, na.rm = TRUE), 
                                           units = "mins")), 1),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  arrange(desc(sequence_num))

# ── Helper to format duration as "Xh Ym" ──
format_duration_hm <- function(total_minutes) {
  hrs  <- floor(total_minutes / 60)
  mins <- round(total_minutes %% 60)

  if (hrs > 0) {
    if (hrs == 1) {
      if (mins == 1) {
        sprintf("%d hour %d min", hrs, mins)
      } else {
        sprintf("%d hour %d mins", hrs, mins)
      }
    } else {
      if (mins == 1) {
        sprintf("%d hours %d min", hrs, mins)
      } else {
        sprintf("%d hours %d mins", hrs, mins)
      }
    }
  } else {
    if (mins == 1) {
      sprintf("%d min", mins)
    } else {
      sprintf("%d mins", mins)
    }
  }
}

# ── Identify the "current" run — highest sequence_num among the compared runs ──
current_run_id <- test_meta$run_id[which.max(test_meta$sequence_num)]

# 2. Build the template block with dynamic placeholders
ticks <- "```"
box_template <- paste0(
  "### %s Summary\n\n",
  ticks, "{r, echo=FALSE}\n",
  "flexdashboard::valueBox(\n",
  "  value   = htmltools::HTML('%s'),\n",
  "  caption = '%s',\n",
  "  icon    = '%s',\n",
  "  color   = '%s'\n",
  ")\n",
  ticks, "\n"
)

# 3. Format and compile the dynamic panels
if (nrow(test_meta) > 0) {
  src <- pmap_chr(test_meta, function(project_name, test_name, run_id, sequence_num, start_time, end_time, duration, ...) {
    # Cleanly format timestamps for the caption
    fmt_start <- format(start_time, "%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S")
    fmt_end   <- format(end_time, "%H:%M:%S")

    is_current <- (run_id == current_run_id)

    # ── SLA status lookup for this run ──
    sla_status <- get_run_sla_status(run_id)

    # ── box_icon — history icon for older runs, status icon for current ──
    # box_icon <- if (!is_current) {
    #   "fa-clipboard-list"                          # older runs — clock/history icon
    # } else if (is.na(sla_status)) {
    #   "fa-clipboard-list"                   # current run, no SLA defined
    # } else if (isTRUE(sla_status)) {
    #   "fa-check-circle"                     # current run PASS
    # } else {
    #   "fa-times-circle"                     # current run FAIL
    # }
    box_icon <- "fa-clipboard-list"

    # box_color <- if (!is_current) {
    #   planitDarkGrey                        # older runs always default color
    # } else if (is.na(sla_status)) {
    #   planitDarkGrey                        # current run, no SLA defined
    # } else if (isTRUE(sla_status)) {
    #   "success"                             # current run PASS
    # } else {
    #   "danger"                              # current run FAIL
    # }
    box_color <- card

    sla_suffix <- if (!is_current) {
      ""                                    # no PASS/FAIL label on older runs
    } else if (is.na(sla_status)) {
      ""
    } else if (isTRUE(sla_status)) {
      " (Current)"
    } else {
      " (Baseline)"
    }
    
    # ── "Current" run highlight ──
    is_current   <- (run_id == current_run_id)

    display_value <- sprintf("%s%s", run_id, sla_suffix)

    # Caption shows the execution window details
    caption_text <- if (is_current) {
      sprintf("Project: <b>%s</b> <br>Test Name: <b>%s</b><br>Test Period: <b>%s - %s</b> <br>Duration: <b>%s</b>", project_name, test_name, fmt_start, fmt_end, format_duration_hm(duration))
     } else {
      sprintf("Project: <b>%s</b> <br>Test Name: <b>%s</b><br>Test Period: <b>%s - %s</b> <br>Duration: <b>%s</b>", project_name, test_name, fmt_start, fmt_end, format_duration_hm(duration))
    }

    sprintf(box_template, run_id, display_value, caption_text, box_icon, box_color)
  })

  cat(knit(text = paste(src, collapse = "\n"), quiet = TRUE))

}
